Dick Sherman is a loyal alumnus of Hamilton College’s Class of 1953. His jazz passion found the perfect outlet on campus with the Catatonic Five and he speaks proudly of his role as drummer and leader of Hamilton’s Alumni All- Stars.
Dick was interviewed in Clinton, New York on June 1, 2006 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
